author: Rainstruck
body:
Lads and Ladies of Avicus, I would like to present the second Ravish Brothers Project...



This will be the very first 4 Team CTW map on Avicus, and we wanted to make sure that these types of maps were started off right!

Map name: Arcadia
Creators: Lavish and RileGuy 
Gamemode: CTW
Download link: https://www.dropbox.com/s/ptkepg65yj6wb73/RileGuy4.zip?dl=0
YML: http://pastebin.com/iFbsDgRZ (Still not done with it yet)
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/N2RrG

Hope You Guys Enjoy it!

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Wow nize!

Good:
+1 Nize detail of the trees.
+1 Nize colors.
+1 New Concept

Bad (not really)
-1 Team sides too close to another. You can jump to the right/left to get to the other side.
-1 Too high wool rooms. You can easily shot off if you pillar up.

Suggestions: 
* Move the quadrants a little bit back (further away from the middle)
* Maybe wool rooms on the ground or a bit lower in the tree.

Overall rating 4/6 (the new concept counts as 2 xD)

Edit: 
Good:
+1 Nize detail of the trees.
+1 Nize colors.
+1 New Concept
+1 Team sides too close to another. You can jump to the right/left to get to the other side.
+1 Too high wool rooms. You can easily shot off if you pillar up.

Bad (not really)
nothing

Suggestions: 
nothing

Overall rating: 5.9 (the new concept counts as 2 xD and there always has to be space for improvements)

replies.author: Lavish
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback so far, we are taking everything into consideration, and
@resepignev We are aware of the teams sides being close to each other, we have done a few things to make sure that doesn't become an issue. About the wool rooms, you don't always have to pillar up, they are other ways to get up, such as the ladders on the tree. xD
